title: Add wtap_buffer_append_epdu_string() to add a string TLV to an EPDU.
description:
That obviates the need to count characters in a string (which is done
incorrectly in some places, as Coverity pointed out in CID 1541122), and
also lets us do a better job of making sure the length fits in 16 bits
(by clamping it at 65535, rather than just casting it to a 16-bit
unsigned integer).

commits_data.title: Add wtap_buffer_append_epdu_string() to add a string TLV to an EPDU.
commits_data.message:
Add wtap_buffer_append_epdu_string() to add a string TLV to an EPDU.

That obviates the need to count characters in a string (which is done
incorrectly in some places, as Coverity pointed out in CID 1541122), and
also lets us do a better job of making sure the length fits in 16 bits
(by clamping it at 65535, rather than just casting it to a 16-bit
unsigned integer).
